_comment: Manual import file for sources that must not be automated. Replace the examples with your own curated entries. Every field here is taken from the official page linked in `official_url` — the importer never infers funding, deadlines, or eligibility. Unverified fields must stay null.

_schema.title: Required. Program/opportunity title as shown by the source.
_schema.official_url: Required. The official page (application or program page).
_schema.country: Country name (used by scoring and filters).
_schema.opportunity_type: scholarship | masters_program | phd_program | funded_program | research_position | graduate_assistantship | fellowship | internship | industry_job | academic_job | other
_schema.degree_level: bachelors | masters | doctorate | any (as stated by the source).
_schema.funding_type: full | partial | self | paid | unknown — only when the source states it explicitly.
_schema.tuition: Number, only if the source publishes an amount.
_schema.deadline: YYYY-MM-DD, only if the source publishes a date.
_schema.skills: Optional list of terms; taxonomy extraction is used when omitted.

opportunities.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) catalogue — funded master's programs
opportunities.organization: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA)
opportunities.field: Multiple fields (filter the catalogue for digital/electronic engineering)
opportunities.funding_type_raw: EMJM scholarships cover tuition and include a living allowance
opportunities.eligibility: Varies per consortium; check each program page in the catalogue.
opportunities.description: Official catalogue of Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters programmes, which are funded by the EU. Filter the catalogue on the official site for engineering/electronics consortia and copy the specific programme URL into a new entry.
opportunities.notes: Catalogue page: re-verify eligibility and deadlines per programme before applying.

opportunities.title: DAAD scholarship database (Germany) — filter for engineering
opportunities.eligibility: Varies per scholarship; see each entry in the database.
opportunities.description: Official DAAD scholarship database for study in Germany. Funding level, deadlines, and eligibility differ per scholarship — record them explicitly only after reading the specific entry.
opportunities.notes: Funding deliberately left as 'unknown' until a specific DAAD scholarship is verified and added as its own entry.
